settings.description: Answers about our pieces, orders and returns.

settings.question: What materials do you use?
settings.answer: Each product page lists its materials and finish. Solid wood, natural fibres and metal details are named where they apply.

settings.question: How should I care for my furniture?
settings.answer: Care guidance for each piece is on its product page. Wipe up spills promptly and keep wood away from direct heat.

settings.question: Can I see a piece before I buy?
settings.answer: Contact us and we will tell you what is available to view and where.

settings.question: How is my order delivered?
settings.answer: Delivery options and estimates are shown at checkout, based on your address and the items in your cart.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and we will tell you what can be changed.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: Our returns terms are listed in the refund policy linked in the footer. Contact us if you have a question about a specific order.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.text: Send us a message and we will get back to you.
